strings.records.zip-rs-1030.body: Crafted ZIP files can escape the extraction directory through symlinks, bypass AES-entry HMAC checks at premature EOF, or terminate extraction through declared sizes. The escape needs knowledge of the destination path; legacy decoder issues require legacy-zip.

strings.records.parse-server-1030.title: Parse Server: stored XSS through malformed Content-Type
strings.records.parse-server-1030.body: A user with upload permission can store malformed Content-Type values. Adapters serving those values can trigger browser MIME sniffing and script execution. Default GridFS is unaffected.

strings.records.daptin-1030.title: Daptin: CPU exhaustion through Accept-Language
strings.records.daptin-1030.body: Unfiltered Accept-Language input reaches the parser on unauthenticated requests. Underscore-separated input bypasses an existing hyphen-count guard. The current API lists no first patched version.
strings.records.daptin-1030.action: Patched versions: not listed in the current API. Match affected ranges, features and privileges to the advisories and restrict exposure.
strings.records.pocketmine-1030.title: PocketMine-MP: repeated packets during login
